stage: The band Canny Alley, four young musicians in their early twenties, real people: (1) a tall skinny young man with long straight ginger-red hair and slightly yellow-tinted round glasses, faded light-blue jeans, lead vocals and electric guitar; (2) a short plump young man with black hair and a natural, well-groomed waxed moustache, a small belly showing under a too-short faded band-logo t-shirt, black leather jacket, keyboards, analog synthesizers and drum pads; (3) an average-looking fit young blonde woman with a small tattoo on her forearm, smiling with an open mouth so her metal dental braces are clearly visible, electronic drum kit and percussion pads, backing vocals; (4) an attractive young woman with long brown hair, a long flowing skirt and a loose oversized knitted sweater, no jacket, nose ring and lip piercing, dark smoky eye makeup, vocals, electric guitar and a small synthesizer.
style_winter: Grainy amateur 35mm film photograph, point-and-shoot camera, realistic skin texture, natural candid moment, cold muted colours with a faint violet-blue cast, eerie indie vibe like a Gorillaz band photo but with real people, wide 16:9 frame.
style_stage: Real concert photography, shot on a high-ISO camera from the photo pit, coloured stage lighting in violet, deep blue and magenta with a few white spot beams, thick stage smoke and haze catching the light, the crowd blurred, heavy grain, raw emotion, realistic skin with sweat, wide 16:9 frame.

w01-snowy-bench.scene: Winter dusk in a city park, the four sit squeezed together on a snow-covered park bench, deadpan expressions, old cast-iron lamp posts glowing behind them, falling snowflakes lit by a harsh on-camera flash as bright specks, blue-hour sky, bare black trees.

w02-frozen-pond.scene: Overcast winter afternoon, the band walks in a line across a frozen park pond carrying a guitar case and a keyboard bag, flat grey light, snow on the ice, bare trees and a distant footbridge, breath vapour in the cold air, candid.

w03-snowball-fight.scene: Night in a snowy park, a chaotic snowball fight between the band members, laughing and shouting, snow exploding in the air, motion blur with a harsh flash freezing them, the blonde grinning wide with her braces showing, lamplight behind.

w04-lamp-post.scene: Late night in a deserted snowy park, the band stands huddled under a single old lamp post in a pool of warm light, everything around them dark blue, fog and breath vapour, snow falling slowly, eerie and lonely, long shadows on the snow.

w05-bandstand.scene: The band plays a small acoustic set inside an old snow-covered park bandstand gazebo decorated with warm string lights, a few bundled-up listeners with umbrellas watching from the snow, dusk, snowflakes, guitar and a small battery keyboard.

w06-misty-path.scene: Misty winter morning on a long tree-lined park path, the band small in the middle of the frame walking towards the camera, thick fog, frost on every branch, snow underfoot, quiet, eerie, album-cover feel.

w07-playground-night.scene: Night, an empty snow-covered children's playground in the park, the band sits on the swings and on a frozen merry-go-round, harsh direct flash, deep black background, falling snow, deadpan and slightly creepy.

w08-hot-drinks.scene: Overcast winter day beside a frozen stone fountain in the park, the band holds steaming paper cups of tea and coffee, red noses and cheeks from the cold, chatting and laughing, breath vapour, snow on the fountain, soft natural light.

c01-from-the-crowd.scene: Wide shot from the middle of the audience: the band performing on a medium club stage, raised hands and phone screens of the crowd blurred in the dark foreground, white beams cutting through violet smoke above the stage, all four members mid-song.

c02-singer-scream.scene: Medium close-up of the lead singer on stage: a tall skinny young man with long straight ginger-red hair and slightly yellow-tinted round glasses, faded jeans, screaming into the microphone with his eyes shut, veins on his neck, sweat flying, electric guitar slung low, backlit by blue beams; the rest of the band blurred behind him.

c03-singer-passion.scene: Close-up on stage of an attractive young woman with long brown hair, nose ring and lip piercing, smudged dark smoky eye makeup, loose knitted sweater, singing passionately with her head tilted back and eyes half closed, hand on her electric guitar, magenta and blue light, strands of hair stuck to her sweaty face, a small synthesizer in front of her; the rest of the band blurred.

c04-drummer-hit.scene: Young blonde woman, average-looking and fit, with a small forearm tattoo, behind an electronic drum kit on stage, caught mid-hit with sticks blurred by motion, hair flying, open-mouthed grin showing her metal dental braces, pure joy, bright beams behind her through smoke, sweat glistening.

c05-keys-lost.scene: A short plump young man with black hair and a natural waxed moustache, too-short band t-shirt and black leather jacket, completely lost in the music behind a stack of analog synthesizers and drum pads, eyes closed, head bobbing, pink and blue light on his face, sweat on his forehead, the crowd blurred in the foreground.

c06-behind-the-band.scene: Shot from behind the band at the back of the stage, the four silhouetted against blinding white and violet stage lights, looking out at a big blurred crowd with raised hands, smoke rolling over the stage, epic and emotional.

c07-shared-mic.scene: The red-haired singer and the brown-haired singer share one microphone at the front of the stage, laughing mid-chorus, foreheads almost touching, guitars between them, warm amber spot plus blue smoke, the drummer and keyboardist blurred behind, a tender happy moment.

c08-confetti-climax.scene: Climax of the show: CO2 jets of white smoke and a burst of confetti fill the air, the band jumps in unison, the singer's arms raised, strobe flash freezing everyone mid-air, crowd hands blurred in the foreground, euphoric.

c09-final-bow.scene: End of the concert: the four stand at the front edge of the stage holding hands and bowing, exhausted and emotional, smiling, sweaty hair, warm white light from above, smoke drifting, the cheering crowd blurred and out of focus.

c10-packed-club.scene: Tiny packed sweaty club gig with a low ceiling, the band playing almost inside the crowd, out-of-focus heads and shoulders very close in the foreground, condensation, red exit sign, violet and blue lights, smoke, raw energy.
